title: Faunal remains and urbanism at Harappa
lineage: Chapter compares original faunal measurements from Mehrgarh, Nausharo and Harappa. The quoted chronological framework predates the new Mehrgarh enamel dates.

passages.locator: pp. 90–94, Figs. 7.1–7.2 and text on Bos
passages.note: The morphometric comparison distinguishes the occupational sequence and documents cattle size variation.
